query:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') as month,
  COUNT(*) as sales_count,
  SUM(quantity * unitPrice) as total_revenue,
  SUM((unitPrice - costPrice) * quantity) as gross_profit
FROM sales_transactions
WHERE userId = 1
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month;
